en.headline: Lee targets September release for Hong Kong’s first five-year plan
en.dek: After a district consultation forum, the Chief Executive said the government aims to publish the plan within the third quarter and wants the subsequent Policy Address issued as soon as possible afterwards.
body: Chief Executive John Lee said on Sunday that the government is working to publish Hong Kong’s first five-year plan within September, following the end of the public consultation period this Friday. He spoke after attending the second district forum on the five-year plan and the 2026 Policy Address.

Lee noted that more than 90 consultation sessions had been held, generating about 13,800 submissions related to the five-year plan and 8,500 related to the Policy Address. He said the two documents are closely linked, with the plan setting the blueprint and the Policy Address outlining implementation priorities.

He added that the gap between the release of the five-year plan and the Policy Address should be as short as possible so the public can clearly understand their relationship. The government is analysing the feedback received.

zh.headline: 李家超：目標9月內發表香港首份五年規劃
zh.dek: 特首出席地區諮詢會後表示，五年規劃諮詢本周五結束，政府目標於第三季即9月內發表，其後盡快公布施政報告。
body: 行政長官李家超周日出席第二場五年規劃及2026年施政報告地區諮詢會後見傳媒，表示五年規劃公眾諮詢將於本周五結束，政府正整理及分析意見，目標於第三季、即9月內發表香港首份五年規劃。
他指自6月展開諮詢以來已舉辦逾90場諮詢會，收到約1.38萬份與五年規劃相關意見及約8500份與施政報告相關意見。五年規劃與施政報告一脈相承，前者是發展藍圖，後者是落實重點。
李家超認為兩者發表時間差距愈短愈好，方便市民了解關係。
